input.quote: c. Limitation on Access. Client will use reasonable commercial efforts consistent with the protection of Client Proprietary Information to restrict access to the Interface to its officers, employees, and agents as may be approved by Client.
input.rationale: No non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-inducement covenant appears anywhere in the Agreement. Searches for "solicit", "employ or engage", "induce ... to leave", "recruit", "personnel/staff/employees" returned only the unsolicited commercial e-mail provision (§ 7) and the access-restriction covenant in § 8(c); the Client covenants (§ 8), confidentiality (§ 10) and indemnity (§ 12) sections contain no personnel restriction, and the only referenced restrictive covenant is the separate Non-Competition Agreement governing Credit Data use (§ 8(d)), which is not a personnel non-solicit. The Agreement therefore sits at our preferred position — Client is under no non-solicitation restriction — so no redline is warranted. Should TrueLink later propose one, we would accept only the fallback: mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of involvement, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
